hana: Small customer ask: allow per-route burst packages on Dedicated, but only for one endpoint.
liz: prefer not to add per-route billing surface unless high ARPU. can we gate per-route to pilot customers?
anya: yes pilot-only initially. GA should be account-level add-on.
morgan: customer success: they want transparent cost estimates in console so they can approve budgets before turning on.
hana: can we show estimated cost per 30-minute burst at current QPS?
pricing-bot: calc example: baseline 5k qps => 30min burst at 3x = 5M tokens => $10k at $0.002/token 
anya: acceptance criteria: 1) cost estimate visible in console per-route + confirm modal, 2) billing emits event with estimated vs actual, 3) legal approves pilot terms.
liz: commercial: trial credit cap $15k for 60 days. overages billed after pilot.
anya: action: hana to run pilot checklist with customer, liz to finalize terms, morgan to update CS playbook, i'll update PRD.
